notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Scholar of the Ages is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages that's tapped and attacking.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
